plugins.name: naratix
plugins.description: Get every product in your catalogue ready to sell, from your AI assistant. Naratix brings in products and taxonomies from Mirakl, VTEX or a file, places products in categories, enriches their attributes, improves their photos, writes titles, descriptions and SEO text, checks quality and audits the taxonomy. You review the results in the chat, and Naratix sends them on to your marketplace, store or PIM. It asks before it launches work or sends anything.
